description:
The apartment offers a welcoming entrance hallway leading through to a generous double bedroom positioned at the front of the property, providing a comfortable and private sleeping space.

To the rear is the open-plan lounge/diner and kitchen, creating a bright and sociable living space. The position overlooking West Street gives the room a lovely outlook and makes this a great space for relaxing or entertaining.

The property also benefits from a modern family bathroom with a bath and shower over.

One of the appealing features of the development is the open external corridor design, giving the building a spacious, airy feel and making the apartment feel very much part of the larger Airpoint complex.

The position is hard to beat, with West Street right on your doorstep and a fantastic selection of everyday amenities close by. With Tesco Express conveniently located beneath the development, grabbing those essentials couldn't be easier.

Bedminster is well known for its independent cafés, restaurants, takeaways, bars and local shops, with North Street, East Street and the surrounding Southville area all within easy reach. Whether you're after your morning coffee, somewhere for dinner or simply a wander around the local shops, there is plenty to explore.

For commuters, the location is particularly convenient. Bedminster and Parson Street railway stations are both nearby, while regular bus services operate from the surrounding streets, providing easy access across Bristol. Bristol city centre is also within easy reach, making this an excellent base for those working in the city. EPC rating: C.
keyFeatures: Excellent selection of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants nearby
